notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures.
description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Gaea's Cradle and Wirewood Lodge.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Formidable Speaker.
Activate Formidable Speaker by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Magus of the Candelabra.
Repeat.
